why_trail.why: The bounded handoff is complete and its settled shared-pair and different-pair decisions define a minimal two-call-site behavior change with focused regressions.

Passing the actual child env into the existing helper makes equality suppression local and explicit: exact shared pairs yield no parent thread, while missing or different child pairs leave ambient parent heartbeating unchanged.
The complete launcher suite and atomic-save confirmatory suite pass; the diff is whitespace-clean, and the seam audit shows one helper plus exactly dispatch and resume call sites.
